name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A four-button formatting bar whose icons reveal a compact bubble with the action name and its keyboard shortcut when hovered or focused.
use: Icon-only controls whose meaning or shortcut is not obvious from the shape alone.
avoid: Touch screens have no hover, and anyone who does not pause on the icon will never see it.
a11y: The bubble opens on focus and closes with Escape, but the animation ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded toolbar of four light icon buttons floats on a black stage, with a faint border around the group. Over the hovered button sits a small rounded dark bubble holding a white label and a grey shortcut in the same line.
behaves: Hovering an icon opens the bubble just above it and the bubble jumps to whichever button the pointer enters. It fades and scales away on leave, and frame one shows the bar with no bubble.
customise: The trigger and content both take children, so any button and any copy fit; offset, arrow and delay are props, while bubble colours are classes.
weight: light: A few buttons and one portal bubble; animation runs only while it opens.
